name: JavaScript - DOM Manipulation
description: Learn to change HTML content with JavaScript

rules.text: Create a paragraph with an id attribute
rules.hint: Add an id to your paragraph: <p id="demo">Original text</p>. IDs help JavaScript find specific elements.

rules.text: Use document.getElementById to select the element
rules.hint: In your script, write: let element = document.getElementById("demo"); This gets the element with id="demo".

rules.text: Change the element's text using innerHTML
rules.hint: Change the text: element.innerHTML = "Text changed by JavaScript!"; innerHTML lets you modify what's inside an element.

completion.message: 🎉 Excellent! You can now control HTML with JavaScript!
